name: MPI Parallelization for Volume Rendering
definition: Parallelization strategy using MPI to decompose the volume by splitting the AMRKDTree in a balanced way, allowing each task to traverse its portion of the tree and read only its assigned data.
summary: MPI Parallelization for Volume Rendering decomposes AMRKDTree data across processes so each renders a full image plane, which are then alpha-blended via tree reduction.
